source: La Moncloa, Referencia del Consejo de Ministros: the simplification addendum's scope
literal: Se han modificado alrededor de 160 medidas. Ejemplos de ello son la eliminación de: (i) lenguaje ambiguo o confuso, (ii) cualquier especificación innecesaria para demostrar el cumplimiento de las medidas de los planes de recuperación, (iii) hitos y objetivos intermedios.

source: La Moncloa, Referencia del Consejo de Ministros: approval of the simplification addendum
literal: ACUERDO por el que se aprueba la Adenda de Simplificación al Plan de Recuperación, Transformación y Resiliencia.

source: La Moncloa, Referencia del Consejo de Ministros: approval of the closing addendum
literal: ACUERDO por el que se aprueba la adenda de cierre del Plan de Recuperación, Transformación y Resiliencia.

source: European Affordable Housing Plan, COM(2025) 1025 (Strasbourg, 16.12.2025): its only mention of Spain
literal: Spain’s Strategic Project for Economic Recovery and Transformation on industrialised construction aims to provide 15,000 affordable, quality and energy-efficient housing units per year, with an investment of EUR 1.3 bn over 10 years expected to mobilise EUR 1.4 of private investment for every public euro.

source: European Affordable Housing Plan: housing in the European Semester
literal: help Member States design effective reforms for affordable and social housing through stronger monitoring and targeted recommendations under the European Semester

source: European Affordable Housing Plan: its only mention of the RRF
literal: Out of its allocated EUR 2.7 billion RRF budget for the provision of social and affordable housing, Portugal launched its Affordable Student Housing (EUR 375 million) that is providing 18,239 beds, 11,795 of which are new, which will increase the existing offer.

source: Regulation (EU) 2021/241, Article 18(4)(i)
literal: envisaged milestones, targets and an indicative timetable for the implementation of the reforms, and investments to be completed by 31 August 2026

source: Regulation (EU) 2021/241, Article 24(1)
literal: Payments of financial contributions and, where applicable, of the loan to the Member State concerned under this Article shall be made by 31 December 2026

source: Commission, NextGenerationEU – The road to 2026, COM(2025) 310
literal: the Commission urges Member States to undertake such plan revisions as soon as possible and, in any event, by the end of 2025

source: Commission, NextGenerationEU – The road to 2026, COM(2025) 310
literal: there is no scope for adopting amendments of RRPs after 31 August 2026

source: Commission, NextGenerationEU – The road to 2026, COM(2025) 310
literal: All payment requests, including the management declarations, the summaries of audits carried out (), and all evidence necessary for their assessment, must be submitted by 30 September 2026

source: Government: launch of the ICO social-housing line
literal: El Gobierno aprueba una línea de préstamos de 4.000 M€ para promover hasta 43.000 viviendas en alquiler asequible

source: Government: approval of the 2023 addendum (loans and REPowerEU)
literal: El Consejo de Ministros ha aprobado la adenda al Plan de Recuperación para su remisión a la Comisión Europea en los próximos días.

source: Government: approval of the «Adenda de Simplificación»
literal: El Consejo de Ministros ha aprobado la Adenda de Simplificación al Plan de Recuperación, Transformación y Resiliencia (PRTR), con el objetivo de agilizar los procesos de verificación y ejecución reduciendo cargas burocráticas, reforzar prioridades estratégicas y optimizar el uso de los recursos disponibles antes de la finalización del Mecanismo de Recuperación y Resiliencia, prevista para el 31 de agosto de 2026.

source: Government: España Crece fund announced
literal: el nuevo fondo España Crece movilizará hasta 23.000 millones de euros públicos y privados para dinamizar la oferta de vivienda y financiar la construcción de 15.000 viviendas al año en España, avanzando con ello “decididamente” en el cierre del déficit habitacional.

source: Government: España Crece capital transfer; cites the December amendment's adoption date
literal: conforme a los términos exigidos en el Anexo a la Decisión de Ejecución del Consejo de 13 de enero de 2026

source: Government: approval of the «Adenda de Cierre»; its stated scope
literal: La Adenda de cierre mejora la redacción de 121 hitos y objetivos y 101 medidas para dar mayor claridad al proceso evaluador y reducir cargas administrativas, aportando mayor seguridad jurídica, sin alterar los objetivos sustantivos de las reformas e inversiones.

source: Government: the closing addendum's loan adjustment
literal: los recursos se adaptan a la demanda demostrada por las empresas y se concentran en las actuaciones más estratégicas, como el nuevo Fondo España Crece, que reforzará la capacidad de inversión y transformación de la economía española más allá de 2026.

source: Government site, ICO loan in Toledo: how the line is described after the August cut
literal: El préstamo se enmarca en la Línea ICO Vivienda, dotada con 4.000 millones de euros, cuyo objetivo es impulsar la construcción de vivienda destinada a ampliar el parque de alquiler social y asequible, así como mejorar el parque público existente mediante fórmulas de colaboración público-privada.

source: Government: sixth payment request
literal: España ha dado un paso decisivo en la ejecución del Plan de Recuperación, Transformación y Resiliencia (PRTR) con la presentación de su sexta solicitud de pago.

source: Government: seventh and last payment request, housing
literal: Vivienda y rehabilitación: Se ha iniciado la construcción de 23.000 viviendas destinadas al alquiler social, de las que 16.000 ya están finalizadas y el resto está previsto que se complete en los próximos meses, y se ha formalizado la línea ICO de promoción de vivienda social, dotada con 568 millones de euros para 4.675 viviendas. En rehabilitación residencial, se han acreditado 53.375 certificados de eficiencia energética, con una reducción media del 30% del consumo de energía primaria no renovable.

source: Government: seventh payment request, size
literal: La solicitud está referida a 148 hitos y objetivos, lo que suponen un 30% del total programados por España.

source: Government (Minister of Economy before the Joint Committee for the EU): adoption of the closing addendum
literal: El 27 de agosto el Consejo adoptó la adenda técnica de cierre, que aclara la redacción de los hitos pendientes y la evidencia que debe aportarse para el último desembolso.

literal: (no operative recommendation on housing)

source: Council Recommendation of 20 July 2020 on the 2020 National Reform Programme of Spain and delivering a Council opinion on the 2020 Stability Programme of Spain 2020/C 282/09
literal: (no operative recommendation on housing)

source: Council Recommendation of 18 June 2021 delivering a Council opinion on the 2021 Stability Programme of Spain
literal: (no operative recommendation on housing)

source: Council Recommendation of 12 July 2022 on the 2022 National Reform Programme of Spain and delivering a Council opinion on the 2022 Stability Programme of Spain
literal: Increase the availability of energy-efficient social and affordable housing, including through renovation.

source: Council Recommendation of 14 July 2023 on the 2023 National Reform Programme of Spain and delivering a Council opinion on the 2023 Stability Programme of Spain
literal: Increase the availability of social and affordable energy-efficient housing, including through renovation, accelerate the electrification of buildings and the penetration of electromobility.

source: Council Recommendation of 21 October 2024 on economic, budgetary, employment and structural policies of Spain
literal: (no operative recommendation on housing)

source: Council Recommendation of 21 January 2025 endorsing the national medium-term fiscal-structural plan of Spain
literal: Project Vienna (new measure) Increase the supply of affordable housing Step 1: By Q4 2025, launch of tenders to provide public land to private promoters for the construction of affordable housing units.

source: Council Recommendation of 8 July 2025 on the economic, social, employment, structural and budgetary policies of Spain
literal: Increase the housing supply by completing the reform of the land law, reducing permitting processing times, eliminating administrative bottlenecks, and preventing labour shortages in the construction sector. … Strengthen the provision of social and affordable housing.

source: Council Recommendation of 10 July 2026 on the economic, social, employment, structural and budgetary policies of Spain
literal: Expand the housing stock, including by reviewing the regulatory framework, streamlining permitting processes, facilitating land availability and repurposing the underutilised building stock. … Increase the provision of affordable and social housing, favouring rental options, better aligned with territorial and regional needs and based on sustainable financing systems that are less dependent on government financing.
